---
description: Save the current ComfyUI session state
---

Review the current conversation and project state.

Update only the appropriate files under project-memory/:

- PROJECT_STATE.md
- CURRENT_TASK.md
- DECISIONS.md
- EXPERIMENTS.md
- WORKFLOW_HISTORY.md

Record:

- What we were trying to accomplish
- What actually worked
- What failed
- Important parameters
- Important decisions
- Workflow changes
- Last successful result
- Current blocker
- Exact next step

Do not record trivial conversation details.

Do not rewrite historical information unnecessarily.

After saving, give me a concise summary of what was persisted.
